admissibility_boundary_hypothesis.description: Theorem hypotheses derived from formalized admissibility boundary geometry.

hypotheses.statement: Continuity stability holds strictly within the interior of the projection_clipping_boundary (ABG-002).
Infinite iterations are stable if the initial state remains within the recursive_stability_boundary (ABG-005).
Transport identities are invariant under orientation_sensitive_window_boundary (ABG-003) refinements.
